visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Each Group Keeps Only Its Last Item
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Words of length 3 are bat, cat and eel and should end up together, but the group for 3 holds only eel.

solution.explanation: The empty array must be created only when the key is new. Creating it every time replaces the group with a fresh empty array, throwing away the items collected so far.
